No. HRM/REC/09/2026 is for one post of Senior Manager - Electrical (E-4) on a fixed term contract, with a fixed consolidated remuneration of Rs.70,000/- per month plus applicable House Rent Allowa

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 42 years. The cut-off date for the age limit and post qualification experience is the date of the walk-in interview, 17 November 2026. content_sections.heading: About EPI
content_sections.text: Engineering Projects (India) Ltd. describes itself in the notice as a 'Mini Ratna' Central Public Sector Enterprise operating under the Ministry of Heavy Industries, Government of India. It executes multifaceted projects on a turnkey basis across the Power, Steel, Industrial, Civil and Infrastructure sectors. This recruitment is for its Project Coordination Office (PCO) at Bhubaneswar, with the place of posting shown as Talcher, Odisha.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: EPI is filling one post of Senior Manager - Electrical (E-4), reserved as UR-01. The essential qualification is B.E. /B.Tech or AMIE or equivalent qualification in Electrical (min 55% marks) . The qualification must be recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education, University Grant Commission and/or any other Statutory Authority/Board. Min. 09 yrs. post qualification executive experience. The gross drawn remuneration should not be less than Rs.7,20,000/- per annum in the candidate's last/current organization. This gross drawn remuneration must be for one year. Required experience: experience in Plant/Coal Handling Plant (CHP) and also in design/detail engineering or handled HT/LT Switchgears, HT/LT Transformers, HT/LT Motors, development Infrastructural Projects consisting of UPS, Lighting, Cable Engineering, Earthing & Lightning Protection System etc. Teaching/training/consultancy/Freelancing experience shall not be treated as relevant experience. Post qualification experience is counted from the date of result/issuance of the mark sheet, which is treated as the date of acquiring the qualification; no relaxation is given on this account. Knowledge in the field of estimation of bill of quantities and basic cost estimation based on Central/State PWD/CPWD rates. Experience in the field of analysis of market rates and preparation of construction schedule. Experience in quality control/quality assurance. The upper age limit is 42 years. The cut-off date for the age limit and post qualification experience is the date of the walk-in interview, 17 November 2026. The notice states that upper age relaxation, as per Presidential Directives, is 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC(NCL) and 10 years for PWD applicants for reserved posts. As this post is unreserved (UR-01), SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates may apply against it if they wish, but age relaxation will not be allowed to them against unreserved posts. Percentage must be stated without rounding off; only the percentage in the consolidated mark sheet is considered. Without a consolidated mark sheet, the average of all semesters/years is taken. Where the university gives no conversion formula, a minimum CGPA of 6 on a 10-point scale is treated as 60%; other scales are prorated. Where the university provides a conversion, the equivalent percentage as per its norms must be shown, and a certificate to this effect may be required at verification/interview. For the full eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Benefits
content_sections.text: HRA: House Rent Allowance as applicable to regular employees of the Company based on the place of posting will be paid. An executive posted in the North East Region will receive a location-based compensatory allowance of 10% of the fixed consolidated remuneration, in addition to the monthly fixed remuneration. Provident Fund benefits as per the Employees Provident Fund Act, 1952. Medical: employees take a self-medical insurance on their own and are entitled to reimbursement of a maximum premium of Rs.3000/- per annum. Gratuity as admissible. An annual increment of 3% is admissible on completion of each year of service, subject to satisfactory performance. The contract is initially for one year and further extendable up to three years, subject to satisfactory performance and organizational requirements. Selected candidates will be required to serve anywhere in India as per the requirement and operational priority of the Company.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Report at the PCO, Bhubaneswar on 17 November 2026; registration is open from 09:00 a.m. to 11:30 a.m. only, and candidates reporting after 11:30 a.m. will not be entertained. Submit the duly filled application form with resume, photograph and self attested copies of testimonials. Original documents of qualification, age, salary etc. are verified; without original certificates the interview of the candidate will not be held. Only applicants who are eligible as per the eligibility criteria will be interviewed. The exercise may take more than one day depending on the number of candidates appearing.

Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature. All correspondence will be made by e-mail to the e-mail ID given in the application form. faq.question: Q1. When and where is the EPI Senior Manager - Electrical walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026 at Engineering Projects (India) Ltd., PCO, Bamra Manor, Flat No. 201, Plot No. 109, Unit - 07, Surya Nagar, Bhubaneswar, Khorda, Odisha-751003.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the EPI walk-in?
faq.answer: Registration is open between 09:00 a.m. and 11:30 a.m. only, and candidates reporting after 11:30 a.m. will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy of Senior Manager - Electrical (E-4), reserved as UR-01, with Talcher, Odisha as the place of posting.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: B.E. /B.Tech or AMIE or equivalent qualification in Electrical with minimum 55% marks, plus minimum 09 years of post qualification executive experience and gross drawn remuneration of not less than Rs.7,20,000/- per annum.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 42 years as on the date of the walk-in interview, 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of EPI Senior Manager - Electrical (E-4)?
faq.answer: The fixed consolidated remuneration is Rs.70,000/- per month plus applicable House Rent Allowance, with a 3% annual increment subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs.70,000 pay?
faq.answer: Yes, House Rent Allowance as applicable to regular employees of the Company based on the place of posting is paid, along with Provident Fund benefits, gratuity as admissible and medical premium reimbursement up to Rs.3000/- per annum.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should be brought to the walk-in?
faq.answer: The filled application form, resume, educational and experience certificates, date of birth proof, proof of one year's gross drawn remuneration with the last 03 months' salary slips, ID proof, a passport size colour photograph, and category certificates if applicable, in original with self attested copies.

faq.question: Q9. Is the EPI Senior Manager post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a fixed term contract, initially for one year and further extendable up to three years subject to satisfactory performance and organizational requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Can SC/ST/OBC candidates get age relaxation for this post?
faq.answer: The post is unreserved; SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates may apply against it, but age relaxation will not be allowed to them against unreserved posts.
